name: New York Big and Quiet Championship 2026

venue.name: Palisades Center
venue.address: 1000 Palisades Center Dr, West Nyack, NY 10994
venue.details: 4th Floor, Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room

information:
This is the New York state championship for big cubes (5x5, 6x6, and 7x7) and quiet events (3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3 Multi-Blind)! This competition is open to everyone, but only New York residents are eligible for New York champion titles - see the Championship Eligibility tab for more info.

There are **separate registration limits** for each event. Out of courtesy for other competitors, please only register for events that you actually plan to compete in. If every individual event has already reached its limit, no further registrations will be accepted, even if the overall limit of 60 hasn't been reached.

4BLD, 5BLD, MBLD: 30 competitors each
5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3BLD, FMC: 40 competitors each

Please avoid bringing unnecessary guests, especially on Days 2 and 3, to help the competition stay quiet.
The Harry & Thelma Adler Community Room is located on the 4th floor in front of the Ice Skating Rink on your right hand side.
